The '''''Spirit of Corellia''''' was a [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]] [[Personal Luxury Yacht 3000/Legends|Personal Luxury Yacht 3000]] in use by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] from the [[Talus base]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
She was donated to the Jedi by [[Abagga Creel]], a wealthy businesswoman from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="card" /> During the [[battle of Talus]] the yacht was used to evacuate Rebel and Jedi personnel from the [[Talus base]]. It was shot down by a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] and crash-landed in a remote region of Corellia. The survivors of the crash, led by [[Rachi Sitra]], then were forced to battle Imperial forces led by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="LS">{{SWGTCG|set=Squadrons Over Corellia|scenario=Light Side scenario campaign}}</ref>
